title: Taming zinc electrodeposition from the root to break zinc utilization/capacity barriers in practical zinc batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1028-1041
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05711F, Paper
Xinhua Zheng, Bibo Han, Chaofan Liu, Ruilin Li, Chengchao Li, Shikai Liu, Faxing Wang, Yuping Wu
This work overcomes Zn utilization (>99%) and areal capacity limits via tailored current collectors. The resulting Zn–Br2 battery delivers 50 mAh cm−2 and 20 000-cycle stability for large-scale energy storage.
